title: Keep local filesystem paths out of browser errors
preconditions: The reviewer can receive missing, malformed, traversal, and foreign-path requests.

steps.action: Request missing pages, unsafe fragment paths, malformed code locations, and missing Saga roots.
steps.expected_result: Each browser-facing response uses a portable public error without local filesystem details.

steps.action: Inspect every response for repository roots, temporary directories, operating-system paths, and internal error phrases.
steps.expected_result: No local path or host diagnostic is present.

expected_result: Pass when browser errors redact portable absolute paths across all exercised failures; fail on any repository, temporary, Windows, UNC, or host path disclosure.
